question: What supreme nature is attributed to the māyā-seed in this declaration?
premises: It is described as without quality
It is described as of supreme self nature
inference: The māyā-seed is qualityless and of the nature of the supreme self.
uncertainties: This contrasts with verse 161 where māyābīja is described as saguṇam.
plain_english: But the māyā-seed, O goddess of gods, is without qualities and of the nature of the supreme self.
